integrity: The supporting proof and standalone symbolic/numerical checker are included; the established Gaussian-mixture law is credited to primary literature. Independent validation has not occurred.
scientific_limitations: Sharp thresholds and exact mode count refer only to the high-dimensional limiting radial histogram; eventual finite-dimensional result guarantees at least two local maxima without explicit cutoff. Fixed symmetric positive switching rates, on stiffness positive and off stiffness zero; no unequal-rate or nonquadratic extension. Numerical verification is not an infinite proof. Publication priority not independently established.
title: Reentrant two-shell radial concentration in a switching harmonic trap
